goal: Prevent callers from silently ignoring getter failures and using invalid or uninitialized output data
Enforce compiler checks across the codebase so failed lookups must be handled
reviewability: Author has been silent for 127 days and a decided fix for a CI failure is not yet pushed
Reviews may wait a long time for an author response
agreement: General support for preventing bugs by enforcing return checks (sedited, ryanofsky)
Nonblocking objection: Assert adds library dependencies or inconsistent debug behavior (ryanofsky)
Approvals on earlier commits without stated reasons (HowHsu, yuvicc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P4 because it adds compile-time hygiene to prevent reading uninitialized out-parameters in wallet getters
Addresses no active wallet bugs and provides only minor safety improvements for developers
